newsitem.title: USA: Spec's says chairman Barry Gibbons leaves.
newsitem.headline: Spec's says chairman Barry Gibbons leaves.

text.p: Spec's Music Inc said Wednesday Barry Gibbons will no longer serve as the chairman of the company's board.
"It's not going to affect our retail operations," said Spec's chief executive Ann Lieff.
Lieff declined to say why Gibbons was leaving but said the company will not name a successor at this time.
Gibbons was not immediately available for comment.
The company posted a loss of $2.1 million, or $0.39 a share, in the quarter ended April 30, compared with a loss of $812,000, or $0.15 a share the year before.
